method: One ordinary-resource public UI fight. Strategy observes only visible DOM distance, phases and energy. All combat input is keyboard events; read-only existing __duel.snapshot is captured for audit only. No injected saves, unlocks, health, time, engine calls, live state changes or artificial speed. Known-rule guided automation, not blind human play.
